records.idCN: 货物/C6海角城/货物/珍珠-特产
records.name: Pearl
records.des: Saltwater Pearl from Cape City that are in high demand on the market, owing to their incredible physical attributes. Their retail price has lowered ever since academic societies worked to improve pearl farming techniques, thus boosting productivity.

records.des: As a seasoning, it provides a one-of-a-kind spiciness to food that enraptures people's taste experience. Relatively popular but also unbearably hot for many others.

records.idCN: 货物/C6海角城/货物/鱿鱼
records.name: Squid
records.des: A mollusk that lives under the sea, with high nutritional value. Its elastic meat has stirred up the boundless imagination of chefs. Other than being served on the table, it is also great in the form of processed snacks.

records.idCN: 货物/C6海角城/货物/带鱼
records.name: Hairtail
records.des: Hairtail's amazing taste and tremendous yield have made it an essential product in seafood markets, especially since people like it for its easy-to-remove bones. Favorite food of the current mayor of Cape City.

records.idCN: 货物/C6海角城/货物/行李箱包
records.name: Luggage
records.des: Travel-related businesses were originally already on the decline when Resonance Pollution first affected the transportation industry, but as things stabilized and the popularity of train transportation rocketed, these businesses also made a comeback. As one of the members of "Gronru City's coastal tourism spots," Cape City has tried and obtained huge success with the introduction of many travel-related products.

records.name: Chaos Money Tree
records.des: A bonsai arrangement, believed to bring luck, made from scraps of raw Chaos Stones that were stripped off during the processing step. Some people think it's too extravagant to turn Chaos Stones into decorations, and its costly retail price also makes it unattainable for those who really need a dose of luck.

records.des: Hairtail's amazing taste and tremendous yield have made it an essential product in seafood markets, especially since people like it for its easy-to-remove bones. Favorite food of the current mayor of Cape City.

records.idCN: 货物/C6海角城/订单/行李箱包

records.idCN: 货物/C6海角城/订单/海角辣椒

records.des: As a seasoning, it provides a one-of-a-kind spiciness to food that enraptures people's taste experience. Relatively popular but also unbearably hot for many others.

records.idCN: 货物/C6海角城/订单/学会书籍-发展投资特产

records.des: A kind of carbonate mineral adored by people for its gorgeous green color and often turned into accessories. People of certain regions believe that letting kids wear Malachite accessories can keep them safe from Resonance Pollution. Perhaps because of its green color, it tends to bring cacti to mind.

records.des: An allotrope of carbon with stable chemical properties, is erosion-proof, and isn't very reactive to chemical agents like acid and alkali. Widely used in numerous sectors. At present, The Wilderness's Graphite is mainly exported to Freeport Ⅶ.

records.idCN: 货物/铁盟哨站/货物/靛红五月军用食品
records.name: Carmine May Military Food
records.des: Carmine May is virtually synonymous with candy and emergency food. The military rations they developed in fulfillment of B.C.R.L.'s requests can provide all required calories and nutrients to people in difficult times, and most importantly, they taste pretty good.

records.idCN: 货物/荒原站/货物/土豆
records.name: Potatoes
records.des: A favorite of many people for its short growth cycle and high yield, among other things. It has become a widely planted cash crop in The Wilderness.

records.idCN: 货物/淘金乐园/货物/沙金-投资特产
records.name: Gold Sand
records.des: Gold formed by separating from quartz veins upon being washed down rock formations by river water. Over two decades ago, it was discovered on the riverbed of the Chess River, which incited a gold rush. Now that the returns of gold mining have become extremely low as a result of depleting resources, Gold Sand has slowly faded out of the public's interest.

records.name: Agate

records.des: A novelty item to liven up an atmosphere by making light out of plastic tubes. Especially common in events like concerts, so much so that waving glow sticks has become a sort of dance to express one's fervor.

records.name: Videotape
records.des: A magnetic tape that's chiefly used to film and play videos. Rumor has it that the people have a strong dislike for it ever since a horror movie that's only released in the form of videotape took the world by storm.

records.idCN: 货物/C8岚心城/订单/纳豆

records.des: A sticky, mildly sweet bean product made by fermenting soybeans with Bacillus subtilis. Has a very high nutritional value, but its unpleasant smell and odd texture tend to keep the majority of people at bay.

records.idCN: 货物/C8岚心城/订单/杯面
records.name: Cup Noodles
records.des: The quintessential instant food. No cooking or any other tableware required. Ready to eat simply by pouring in hot water. Its convenience, affordability, and flavors have made it earn the favor of many consumers, particularly individuals who are single.
